# Shariful Hasan Roky — Revenue Growth Strategist

> Revenue growth strategist for ecommerce and home services brands. 4+ years, 150+ companies, 2 niches, 60+ countries.

## Who I am

I'm Shariful Hasan Roky, an independent revenue growth strategist based in Feni, Bangladesh. I build full-funnel paid + lifecycle systems for ecommerce founders and home services owners across the US, Canada, UK, and Australia.

## What I do

I run a 6-chapter system for every client, in this order: **campaign → business → scaling → numbers → measurements → growth**. Skip one and scale breaks at month 9.

- **Campaign**: Hook-led creative testing on Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube. Server-side tracking with CAPI. Weekly creative refresh.
- **Business**: Unit economics, CAC:LTV modeling, offer engineering, cash-cycle aware budget pacing.
- **Scaling**: Horizontal + vertical scaling, budget laddering (20% bumps every 48-72h), SOP-ized so it survives team churn.
- **Numbers**: Revenue, MER (blended ROAS), blended CAC, payback period — the only four numbers that move a business.
- **Measurements**: Server-side GTM + Conversions API, offline conversion import, call tracking, MMM + incrementality for channels above $50k/mo.
- **Growth**: Lifecycle email/SMS, brand creative, referral loops, quarterly growth experiments.

## Case studies (12 total)

### Featured (2)
- **Origani** — Sydney, Australia. Australian Shopify ecommerce store. Scaled from 2x to 13x ROI in 6 months. $420k/mo revenue (+540%). Blended CAC $18 (−62%).
- **Calgary Cleaning** — Calgary, AB, Canada. Local residential cleaning. 100 qualified leads per month at $24/lead (−71%). Booking rate 48%.

### Other ecommerce case studies
- DTC Electronics Brand — United States. Microsoft Advertising expansion. 620K tracked purchase value, CAC −31%.
- Downioa — United States. Shopify DTC. Google PMax + server-side CAPI. 1.39K conversions, $259K conversion value, 764% actual ROAS.
- VSL Lead Gen — United States. Video Sales Letter funnel on Facebook Ads. 531 VSL leads at $8.44 each. 4 angle-tested ad sets.
- Meta Ads · CYNTHIA — United States. Film niche ecommerce, 7 parallel FB campaigns. $43,869 spend, 666,980 reach, 2.58M impressions.

### Home services case studies
- Tint Shop — United States. Auto window tinting. 445 tracked phone calls + 250 quote requests in 6 months.
- Home Service Group — United States. Multi-location HVAC + plumbing. 434K impressions, 1.16K conversions at $38 CPA.
- Service Pro Network — United States. Call-only campaigns. 655 tracked calls, CTR 2.72%.
- Lead Gen · 13 Campaigns — United States. 13-campaign lead-gen account. 488 conversions, 7 lead forms + 56 phone calls tracked.
- Call-Heavy Lead Gen — United States. 184 tracked phone calls, 759 total conversions over 16 months.
- Meta Ads · Lifetime Budgets — United States. 8 lifetime-budget FB campaigns. $8,415 spend, 1,046,005 reach, 2,116,059 impressions.

This site is a single-page Next.js 16 application with client-side view switching. The navbar exposes: Pillars, Numbers, About, Portfolio, Case Studies, CV, Book a Call. All content is rendered into the DOM on initial page load and accessible to JavaScript-capable crawlers.
